dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Morning {NICKNAME}, morning Paimon! Thought I'd come over and say hi, puffer floaters and all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Morning, Mualani! How are you so full of energy? Weren't you the one partying the hardest last night!?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: That was last night! I got a good night's sleep, and now I'm good as new!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Here, take this. It's your prize for completing the album — I picked yours up too, to save you the trip!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! Thanks, Mualani! That was so nice!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: When it comes to helping people, a good guide always thinks one step ahead, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Oh, and speaking of work, I guess our vacation's almost over, huh... Probably for the best. If I don't head back soon, I'm worried my little doggie won't even remember me.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: And after talking to the others, it seems like everyone is just about ready to get back.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Some are missing their families, others are going through Dandelion Wine withdrawal, I guess...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Even Chasca seems to be feeling it. Not that she'd ever admit it, but I have noticed her gazing back towards the Flower-Feather Clan at night.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: But summer's not over yet! So I say... we squeeze a few more unforgettable moments into the time we've got left!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, how about taking one right here? After all this time, Paimon's grown kind of attached to this place.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Great idea! Why don't you spruce up this wall, and I'll go gather the others. See you over at the plaza!
